name: SPX Opening Range Breakout Analysis
description: Research study analyzing opening range breakouts (09:30-09:45 AM ET) for SPY (S&P 500). Measures the probability of 'false breakouts' - when price breaks the opening range in one direction but then also breaks in the opposite direction during the same trading day.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SPX OPENING RANGE BREAKOUT ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Research Question: When price breaks the opening range (09:30-09:45 AM ET),
# what is the probability it also breaks in the opposite direction same day?
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1Min)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
open_price = src.o

# === INDEX FOR TIME EXTRACTION ===
bar_idx = index()

# === OPENING RANGE SESSION (09:30-09:45 AM ET) ===
or_window = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='09:45', tz='America/New_York'))()
or_high = or_window.high
or_low = or_window.low
or_closed = or_window.closed

# === FULL RTH SESSION (09:30-16:00 ET) ===
rth_session = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))()
in_rth = rth_session.active
rth_closed = rth_session.closed

# === OPENING RANGE WIDTH (%) ===
or_width_pct = ((or_high - or_low) / or_low * 100) if or_closed else 0

# === BREAKOUT CONDITIONS (only after OR closes, during RTH) ===
after_or = or_closed and in_rth
upside_break = high > or_high and after_or
downside_break = low < or_low and after_or

# === TRACK FIRST BREAKOUT DIRECTION PER DAY ===
# Use session_agg to detect first occurrence of each breakout type
upside_break_count = session_agg(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Sum)(upside_break)
downside_break_count = session_agg(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Sum)(downside_break)

# First upside breakout happens when count goes from 0 to 1
upside_first_bar = upside_break and (upside_break_count == 1)
downside_first_bar = downside_break and (downside_break_count == 1)

# Track which direction broke first (1 = upside, -1 = downside, 0 = neither yet)
# Use session_agg with Max to persist the first breakout throughout the day
upside_first_signal = 1 if upside_first_bar else 0
downside_first_signal = -1 if downside_first_bar else 0
first_direction_raw = upside_first_signal + downside_first_signal
first_direction = session_agg(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Max)(first_direction_raw * 100)

# === DETECT TWO-WAY BREAKOUTS ===
# Day started with upside breakout
day_was_upside_first = first_direction > 50

# Day started with downside breakout  
day_was_downside_first = first_direction < -50

# Did opposite direction also break?
upside_then_downside = day_was_upside_first and (downside_break_count > 0)
downside_then_upside = day_was_downside_first and (upside_break_count > 0)

# === DAILY FLAGS (use rth_closed to get end-of-day values) ===
had_or = or_closed and rth_closed
upside_first_day = day_was_upside_first and rth_closed
downside_first_day = day_was_downside_first and rth_closed
false_breakout_up = upside_then_downside and rth_closed
false_breakout_down = downside_then_upside and rth_closed

# === TIME TO BREAKOUTS (minutes from OR close at 09:45) ===
bars_since_or_close = barssince()(or_closed)
minutes_since_or_close = bars_since_or_close

# Capture minute of first upside breakout
minute_to_upside = where(upside_first_bar, minutes_since_or_close)
minute_to_downside = where(downside_first_bar, minutes_since_or_close)

# For days where opposite also broke, capture that timing
minute_to_opposite_after_up = where(day_was_upside_first and downside_first_bar, minutes_since_or_close)
minute_to_opposite_after_down = where(day_was_downside_first and upside_first_bar, minutes_since_or_close)

# === DIRECTION LABELS FOR TABLES ===
direction_label = 'Upside First' if upside_first_day else ('Downside First' if downside_first_day else 'No Breakout')

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 1: SUMMARY CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Opening Range Breakout Statistics',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Total Trading Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                info='Days with valid opening range'
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Upside First Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_color=Color.Green,
                info='Days where upside broke before downside'
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Downside First Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_color=Color.Red,
                info='Days where downside broke before upside'
            )
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary'
)(had_or, upside_first_day, downside_first_day)

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='False Breakout Rates',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Upside → Downside %',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=1,
                card_color=Color.Warning,
                info='% of upside-first days that also broke downside'
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Downside → Upside %',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=1,
                card_color=Color.Warning,
                info='% of downside-first days that also broke upside'
            )
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary'
)(false_breakout_up, false_breakout_down)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 2: DAILY BREAKDOWN TABLE
# =============================================================================

detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Daily Breakout Details',
        include_timestamp=True,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='OR High', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='OR Low', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='OR Width %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='First Direction', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='False Breakout', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. Daily Data'
)(or_high, or_low, or_width_pct, direction_label, false_breakout_up or false_breakout_down)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 3: COMPARISON CHARTS
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='False Breakout Rate by Initial Direction',
    category='3. Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Initial Breakout Direction',
    y_axis_label='False Breakout Rate',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Upside → Downside', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Downside → Upside', color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(false_breakout_up, false_breakout_down)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 4: OPENING RANGE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

timeseries_lines(
    title='Opening Range Width Over Time',
    category='4. Opening Range',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='OR Width %', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(or_width_pct)

histogram(
    title='Opening Range Width Distribution',
    category='4. Opening Range',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='OR Width (%)',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(or_width_pct)

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Opening Range Statistics',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Width %', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Width %', card_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min Width %', card_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Opening Range'
)(or_width_pct, or_width_pct, or_width_pct)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 5: TIMING ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

histogram(
    title='Time to First Breakout (Minutes from 09:45)',
    category='5. Timing',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Green,
    x_axis_label='Minutes',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat
)(minute_to_upside)

histogram(
    title='Time to Downside Breakout (Minutes from 09:45)',
    category='5. Timing',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Red,
    x_axis_label='Minutes',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat
)(minute_to_downside)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Breakout Timing Statistics',
        col_headers=['Upside First', 'Downside First'],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Avg Minutes to First Breakout', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            RowSpec(name='Median Minutes to First', agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='5. Timing'
)(minute_to_upside, minute_to_downside)
